title: HI Cyber Con 2026 CTF
description:
HI Cyber Con 2026 CTF is an international 48-hour Jeopardy-style Capture The Flag competition organized by Hidden Investigations.

The competition features 70+ challenges covering web, forensics, steganography, network, crypto, binary exploitation, reverse engineering, AI/LLM, hardware, blockchain, OSINT, and misc.

The CTF is fully online and open to teams of up to 5 participants worldwide.

Competition Divisions: HI Cyber Con 2026 features two divisions: Human-Led (AI permitted for reference only) and Agentic AI (AI-assisted and autonomous challenge solving permitted). Both divisions are eligible for the same overall USD 2,500 cash prize pool. Participation is free, with teams of 1–5 members.

Discord: https://discord.gg/rD2gHUWJhf

title: 2026 Qiangwang Challenge on Cyber Mimic Defense Qualification
description:
The 2026 Qiangwang Challenge on Cyber Mimic Defense Qualification is the online qualifying round of the 9th Qiangwang International Elite Challenge on Cyber Mimic Defense.

This team-based Jeopardy CTF features standard CTF challenges and selected challenges on endogenous security. Teams can register through the official event website.

Eligible teams will be selected for the on-site finals, which are planned to take place in Nanjing, China. Please refer to the official website for competition rules, qualification details and further announcements.

Registration and event information:
https://nest.pmlabs.com.cn/#/events/qiangwang-9/registration
